short_description.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote, sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal bersayap kelelawar. Ceritanya mungkin berasal dari kelelawar vampir.
short_description.en: The Piuchén is a blood-sucking creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology, often appearing as a flying snake or a bat-winged lizard. The lore may derive from the vampire bat.

long_description.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote yang dikenal di sebagian besar Chile. Ia sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar yang mengeluarkan siulan atau desis yang melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa. Ia juga digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran burung, ikan, dan manusia, atau pengubah wujud.
long_description.en: The Piuchén is a vampiric creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology known across much of Chile. It often appears as a flying snake or large bat-winged lizard whose whistles or hisses stun or kill prey. It has also been pictured as a composite of bird, fish and human, or as a shapeshifter that takes animal forms.

long_description.id: Menurut kisah Mapuche, ia terbang pada malam hari dan mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur di hutan, menyukai musim ketika pohon roble bertunas, dan dianggap roh hutan. Bentuknya berbeda-beda: ular bersayap berbulu di Vichuquén, ular hitam bersayap berbulu kaku di sekitar Santiago, atau makhluk berparuh beo, bertubuh kodok, dan berekor ular di Ovalle. Dalam cerita Chilote ia campuran manusia, ular, burung, dan ikan yang menghuni danau dan sungai, membangkitkan gelombang raksasa, dan merobohkan pohon besar.
long_description.en: In the Mapuche account it flies at night and sucks the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest, favors the season when roble trees sprout, and is regarded as a forest spirit. Its form varies: a serpent with feathered wings in Vichuquén, a black winged snake with a bristly body near Santiago, or a creature with a parrot's beak, toad-like body and snake-like tail in Ovalle. In Chilote lore it is a composite of human, snake, bird and fish that dwells in lakes and rivers, raises gigantic waves and knocks down huge trees.

long_description.id: Untuk melawannya, disarankan menyumbat lubang pohon tempat tinggalnya lalu membakar pohon itu; takhayul di Ovalle menganjurkan bendera putih atau bersiul ke dalam botol. Sumber menyebut machi bersekutu dengannya, tetapi juga diklaim hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkannya dengan ramuan herbal. Sebuah teks sejarah alam yang didigitalkan melukiskan "Piguchén" sebagai hewan bersayap selaput sebesar kelinci yang tidak mencelakai siapa pun selain serangga, dan ensiklopedia daring mencatat bahwa ceritanya mungkin berasal dari kelelawar vampir.
long_description.en: To fight it, it is suggested to plug the tree hollow where it lives and set the tree on fire; superstition in Ovalle recommends a white flag or whistling in a bottle. One source says the machi were in alliance with it, but it is also claimed that only the machi can defeat it with herbal cures. A digitized natural history text depicts the "Piguchén" as a rabbit-sized, membrane-winged animal that harms no one but insects, and the online encyclopedia notes that the lore may derive from the vampire bat.

literal_meaning.id: burung mitos atau kelelawar; ular terbang (mungkin dari piwn "mengeringkan" + ché "orang")
literal_meaning.en: mythic bird or bat; flying serpent (possibly from piwn "to dry" + ché "people")

who.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah, sering berupa ular terbang atau kadal bersayap kelelawar.
who.en: The Piuchén is a blood-sucking creature, often a flying snake or bat-winged lizard.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote dan dikenal di sebagian besar Chile.
origin.en: It comes from Mapuche and Chilote mythology and is known across much of Chile.

role.id: Ia dianggap roh hutan yang mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur.
role.en: It is considered a forest spirit that sucks the blood of sleeping animals and humans.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal dengan siulan atau desis yang melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa.
famous_for.en: It is known for whistles or hisses that stun or kill prey.

did_you_know.id: Nama "Piuchén" juga dipakai dalam bahasa Spanyol sehari-hari untuk kelelawar vampir biasa, Desmodus rotundus.
did_you_know.en: The name "Piuchén" is also used in everyday Spanish for the common vampire bat, Desmodus rotundus.

description.id: Ia sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal bersayap kelelawar dan terbang pada malam hari.
description.en: It often appears as a flying snake or bat-winged lizard and flies at night.

description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai pengubah wujud; di usia tua ular bersayap dapat berubah menjadi burung sebesar ayam jantan atau kalkun muda.
description.en: It is described as a shapeshifter; in old age the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized or young-turkey-sized bird.

description.id: Desis dan tatapannya dianggap dapat membunuh mangsa, atau tatapannya melumpuhkan korban sebelum darahnya diisap.
description.en: Its hiss and gaze are considered capable of killing prey, or its gaze may paralyze the victim before its blood is drunk.

description.id: Menurut seorang narasumber di sekitar Santiago, bulu kaku tubuhnya mematikan bila menyentuh kulit.
description.en: According to an informant near Santiago, the bristles of its body are deadly poison on contact with skin.

description.id: Menurut cerita Chilote, ia konon dapat membangkitkan gelombang raksasa yang menenggelamkan perahu.
description.en: In Chilote lore it can allegedly raise gigantic waves that sink boats.

description.id: Untuk membunuh Pihuchén di lubang pohon, disarankan menyumbat lubang dengan kain tebal lalu membakar pohonnya.
description.en: To kill a Pihuchén in a tree hollow, it is suggested to plug the hole with heavy cloth and set the tree on fire.

description.id: Menurut satu klaim, hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkannya karena ia dapat menangkal hipnosisnya dengan ramuan herbal.
description.en: According to one claim, only the machi can defeat it because the machi can counteract its hypnosis with herbal cures.

name.en: White flag and whistling in a bottle

description.en: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward it off.

description.en: A black winged snake about 0.5 metres long with a bristly body, whose victims were cattle.

description.id: Makhluk berparuh dan bersayap beo, bertubuh kodok, dan berekor ular.
description.en: A creature with a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail.

description.id: Makhluk campuran manusia, ular, burung, dan ikan yang menghuni danau dan sungai.

learning_questions.en: How can real animals give rise to mythical ones?

sources.title: Compendio de la historia geografica natural y civil del reyno de Chile - Parte I, página 307
sources.author: Juan Ignacio Molina

claims.quote: is a vampiric creature from the Mapuche mythology and Chilote mythology known in much of  Chile.

statement.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote yang dikenal di sebagian besar Chile.
statement.en: The Piuchén is a vampiric creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology known across much of Chile.

claims.quote: This blood-sucker often assumes the guise of a flying snake, or a large lizard with bat wings, that emits strange whistling sounds or hisses that stun or kill its enemy or prey.

statement.id: Pengisap darah ini sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar yang siulan atau desisnya melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa.
statement.en: It often appears as a flying snake or a bat-winged lizard whose whistles or hisses stun or kill prey.

claims.quote: The lore may have derived from encounters with the common vampire bat.

statement.id: Cerita ini mungkin berasal dari pertemuan dengan kelelawar vampir.
statement.en: The lore may come from encounters with the common vampire bat.

claims.quote: The Piuchén (Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén) or Piguchen (Piguchén)

statement.id: Piuchén juga ditulis Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén, atau Piguchen (Piguchén).
statement.en: The Piuchén is also written Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén, or Piguchen (Piguchén).

claims.quote: The name Piuchén (Piuchénes) derives from Mapuche Piwichen (also styled piwicheñ, pihuicheñ) for "mythic bird, bat" or "flying serpent". The piwichen may further break down into piwn 'to dry' + ché 'people'.

statement.id: Nama Piuchén berasal dari kata Mapuche Piwichen untuk "burung mitos, kelelawar" atau "ular terbang"; kata itu mungkin terurai menjadi piwn "mengeringkan" + ché "orang".
statement.en: The name Piuchén derives from Mapuche Piwichen for "mythic bird, bat" or "flying serpent"; the word may break down into piwn "to dry" + ché "people".

claims.quote: It is also described as an avian-piscine-human composite, or a shapeshifter taking on the form of animals.

statement.id: Ia juga digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran burung, ikan, dan manusia, atau pengubah wujud yang mengambil bentuk hewan.
statement.en: It is also described as an avian-piscine-human composite, or a shapeshifter taking on the form of animals.

claims.quote: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest. It prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts, and is considered a forest spirit.

statement.id: Ia terbang pada malam hari dan mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur di hutan; ia menyukai musim ketika pohon roble bertunas dan dianggap roh hutan.
statement.en: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest; it prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts and is considered a forest spirit.

claims.quote: In various versions with local variations, it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or alternatively a large lizard with bat wings.

statement.id: Dalam berbagai versi lokal, ia dapat berupa ular bersayap berbulu (seperti diceritakan di Vichuquén) atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar.
statement.en: In various local versions it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or a large lizard with bat wings.

claims.quote: The Pihuchén is a black winged snake about 0.5 metres (1.6 ft) in length, with a bristly body, according to the lore in the vicinity of Santiago, whose cattle fell victim.

statement.id: Menurut cerita di sekitar Santiago, Pihuchén adalah ular hitam bersayap sepanjang sekitar 0,5 meter dengan tubuh berbulu kaku, yang memangsa ternak.
statement.en: According to lore near Santiago, the Pihuchén is a black winged snake about 0.5 metres long with a bristly body, whose victims were cattle.

claims.quote: The informant stated the bristles were deadly poison upon contact with skin, making (live) capture an impossible task, hence the eradication by fire without handling the beast.

statement.id: Narasumber menyatakan bulu kakunya mematikan bila menyentuh kulit sehingga menangkapnya hidup-hidup mustahil, maka makhluk itu dibasmi dengan api tanpa disentuh.
statement.en: The informant stated the bristles were deadly poison on contact with skin, making live capture impossible, hence eradication by fire without handling the beast.

claims.quote: The creature enjoys incredible longevity, and in old age, the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized bird, or a young turkey sized bird.

statement.id: Makhluk ini berumur sangat panjang, dan di usia tua ular bersayap itu dapat berubah menjadi burung sebesar ayam jantan atau kalkun muda.
statement.en: The creature enjoys incredible longevity, and in old age the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized or young-turkey-sized bird.

claims.quote: In another telling from Ovalle in the Coquimbo Region, the Piuchén "has a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail".

statement.id: Dalam versi lain dari Ovalle di Wilayah Coquimbo, Piuchén "berparuh dan bersayap beo, bertubuh seperti kodok, dan berekor seperti ular".
statement.en: In another telling from Ovalle in the Coquimbo Region, the Piuchén "has a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail".

claims.quote: Others considered its hiss and gaze capable of killing prey, or the gaze may paralyze the victim and the creature then leisurely feeds on the blood of the stupefied victim.

statement.id: Sebagian menganggap desis dan tatapannya dapat membunuh mangsa, atau tatapannya melumpuhkan korban sehingga makhluk itu santai mengisap darahnya.
statement.en: Others considered its hiss and gaze capable of killing prey, or the gaze may paralyze the victim so the creature leisurely feeds on its blood.

claims.quote: In Chilote folklore, the creature is described as a protean composite creature, part human, snake, bird, and fish, and covered with all sorts of things such as grass, bushes, and twisted horn-like protrusions

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Chilote, makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran yang berubah-ubah, sebagian manusia, ular, burung, dan ikan, tertutup rumput, semak, dan tonjolan seperti tanduk yang berpilin.
statement.en: In Chilote folklore the creature is described as a protean composite, part human, snake, bird and fish, covered with grass, bushes and twisted horn-like protrusions.

claims.quote: preferring to dwell in lakes and rivers, haunting the local Lake Huillinco. It allegedly can raise gigantic waves that cause nearby boats to sink.

statement.id: Ia lebih suka tinggal di danau dan sungai serta menghantui Danau Huillinco setempat; konon ia dapat membangkitkan gelombang raksasa yang menenggelamkan perahu di dekatnya.
statement.en: It prefers to dwell in lakes and rivers, haunting the local Lake Huillinco, and can allegedly raise gigantic waves that sink nearby boats.

claims.quote: The piuchén is so powerful it effortlessly knocks down this Chilean larch (alerces), the tique ... or other huge trees, according to Chilote lore

statement.id: Menurut cerita Chilote, piuchén begitu kuat sehingga tanpa kesulitan merobohkan alerce (cemara Chile), tique, atau pohon raksasa lain.
statement.en: According to Chilote lore the piuchén is so powerful it effortlessly knocks down the Chilean larch (alerces), the tique or other huge trees.

claims.quote: it is also claimed that only the machi alone can defeat the creature, as he or she can counteract the hypnosis with herbal cures.

statement.id: Juga diklaim bahwa hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkan makhluk itu karena ia dapat menangkal hipnosis dengan ramuan herbal.
statement.en: It is also claimed that only the machi can defeat the creature, as he or she can counteract the hypnosis with herbal cures.

claims.quote: Mapuche belief was that the Pihuichéñ coordinated its attacks with the machi (herbal healer), and they were in alliance

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan Mapuche, Pihuichéñ mengoordinasikan serangannya dengan machi (tabib herbal) dan keduanya bersekutu.
statement.en: According to Mapuche belief the Pihuichéñ coordinated its attacks with the machi (herbal healer), and they were in alliance.

claims.quote: to kill a Pihuchén living in a Tree hollow (hueco), it is suggested the hole be plugged with hefty cloth then to set the tree on fire.

statement.id: Untuk membunuh Pihuchén yang tinggal di lubang pohon, disarankan menyumbat lubang dengan kain tebal lalu membakar pohonnya.
statement.en: To kill a Pihuchén living in a tree hollow, it is suggested to plug the hole with heavy cloth and then set the tree on fire.

claims.quote: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward the creature off, and adds that adding white goat to one's flock diminishes the chance of being attacked.

statement.id: Takhayul di Ovalle menganjurkan mengibarkan bendera putih atau bersiul ke dalam botol untuk menangkal makhluk itu, dan menambah kambing putih ke kawanan mengurangi peluang diserang.
statement.en: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward the creature off, and adding a white goat to one's flock lessens the chance of attack.

claims.quote: According to modern zoologists, this species name is a disused synonym of Desmodus rotundus, the common vampire bat, also known by the Spanish vernacular "Piuchén".

statement.id: Menurut zoolog modern, nama spesies itu sinonim lama dari Desmodus rotundus, kelelawar vampir biasa, yang dalam bahasa Spanyol sehari-hari juga disebut "Piuchén".
statement.en: According to modern zoologists this species name is a disused synonym of Desmodus rotundus, the common vampire bat, also known by the Spanish vernacular "Piuchén".

claims.quote: The abbot Juan Ignacio Molina also wrote a paragraph on the "winged quadruped, or a kind of large bat". A later lexicographer remarked that Molina had been deceived by a gift of some dead rare animal claimed to be a piuchén, and the abbot only described such cadaver in detail.

statement.id: Abbé Juan Ignacio Molina juga menulis satu paragraf tentang "kuadruped bersayap, atau sejenis kelelawar besar"; seorang leksikograf kemudian menyatakan Molina tertipu oleh hadiah bangkai hewan langka yang diklaim sebagai piuchén sehingga ia hanya menggambarkan bangkai itu.
statement.en: The abbot Juan Ignacio Molina also wrote a paragraph on the "winged quadruped, or a kind of large bat"; a later lexicographer remarked that Molina had been deceived by a gift of a dead rare animal claimed to be a piuchén and only described that cadaver.

claims.quote: He wonders if the Piguchén might have been the precursor of the Chupacabra.

statement.id: Penulis bertanya-tanya apakah Piguchén mungkin pendahulu Chupacabra.
statement.en: The author wonders whether the Piguchén might have been the precursor of the Chupacabra.

claims.quote: Tal es por exemplo el Piguchén, quadrúpedo alado, ó especie de gran murciegalo, que á exîstir en la realidad, formaria uno de los eslabones ú anillos que unen los páxaros á los quadrúpedos.

statement.id: Sebuah teks sejarah alam yang didigitalkan menyebut Piguchén sebagai kuadruped bersayap atau sejenis kelelawar besar yang, andai nyata, akan menjadi salah satu mata rantai penghubung burung dan kuadruped.
statement.en: A digitized natural history calls the Piguchén a winged quadruped or kind of large bat which, if it really existed, would be one of the links joining birds to quadrupeds.

claims.quote: Este animal, que segun dicen, es de la magnitud y figura del conejo casero, está cubierto de un pelo fino de color de canela: tiene el hocico aguzado: los ojos grandes, redondos y resplandecientes: las orejas casi invisibles: las alas membranosas: las patas cortas, y semejantes á las del lagarto

statement.id: Menurut teks itu, hewan ini konon sebesar dan berbentuk seperti kelinci rumahan, berbulu halus berwarna kayu manis, berhidung runcing, bermata besar bulat dan berkilau, bertelinga nyaris tak tampak, bersayap selaput, dan berkaki pendek seperti kadal.
statement.en: According to the text, this animal is said to be the size and shape of the domestic rabbit, covered with fine cinnamon-colored hair, with a pointed muzzle, large round shining eyes, almost invisible ears, membranous wings and short legs like a lizard's.

claims.quote: silva como las culebras, y vuela como las perdices: habita en los huecos de los árboles, de donde sale unicamente durante la noche, y no hace mal á nadie sino es á los insectos, que le sirven de pasto.

statement.id: Menurut teks itu, hewan ini bersiul seperti ular, terbang seperti burung perdiz (partridge), tinggal di lubang pohon dan keluar hanya pada malam hari, dan tidak mencelakai siapa pun kecuali serangga yang menjadi makanannya.
statement.en: According to the text, the animal hisses like snakes, flies like partridges (perdiz), lives in tree hollows from which it comes out only at night, and harms no one except the insects that serve as its food.

topic.en: Nature and diet of the Piguchén

summary.id: Dalam kisah Mapuche dan cerita rakyat, makhluk ini mengisap darah hewan dan manusia, dan di sekitar Santiago ternak menjadi korbannya.
summary.en: In Mapuche and folk accounts the creature sucks the blood of animals and humans, and near Santiago cattle fell victim to it.

summary.id: Teks sejarah alam yang didigitalkan menyebut "Piguchén" tidak mencelakai siapa pun kecuali serangga yang menjadi makanannya, dan ensiklopedia daring mencatat seorang leksikograf menyatakan penulisnya tertipu oleh bangkai hewan langka.
summary.en: The digitized natural history text says the "Piguchén" harms no one but the insects it feeds on, and the online encyclopedia records a lexicographer's remark that its author had been deceived by a dead rare animal.

summary.id: Menurut kepercayaan Mapuche, Pihuichéñ bersekutu dengan machi.
summary.en: According to Mapuche belief the Pihuichéñ was in alliance with the machi.

summary.id: Juga diklaim hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkan makhluk itu dengan ramuan herbal.
summary.en: It is also claimed that only the machi can defeat the creature with herbal cures.
